_note: #392. A gate command that, on an event, runs only in workflows that carry a paths or paths-ignore filter for it is a finding per workflow and event. ci.yml filters pull_request and push, so both are found. lint-only-src.yml is a trap: lint-all.yml runs the same lint on pull_request with no filter, so it is covered, and the registry entry that excuses it is stale. docs.yml is filtered and runs no gate (a printed `pnpm verify` is not a run). excused.yml is excused by a dated entry.

details..github/workflows/ci.yml#on.pull_request: runs pnpm verify on pull_request with a paths or paths-ignore filter
